name: Brainly
summary: Homework help platform with AI explanations, test prep and optional human tutoring.
description: Brainly helps students with homework and turns missed topics into test preparation, with a learning advisor included and a weekly human tutor available as an add-on, according to its site description. The service is aimed at parents of teenagers as well as students.

howToUse.title: Open Brainly
howToUse.description: Go to Brainly. The service is aimed at students and at parents of teenagers.

howToUse.title: Work from homework
howToUse.description: Bring homework in so missed topics become test preparation.

howToUse.title: Use the advisor or add a tutor
howToUse.description: Use the learning advisor included with the service, or add the weekly human tutor as an add-on.
